caveats: ⚑ skill1 trigger identity: kit says 'Activates when recovering Cover's HP'. The engine's `recovery` trigger fires on ANY heal reaching the unit, but a NIKKE ally heal restores the unit's HP, not Cover HP — keying to `recovery` would over-fire with any healer teammate (helm/crown comps). The only kit-stated Cover-HP restore is her own skill2 burst-cast line, so BOTH skill1 blocks are keyed to `burstCast` (self). Under-fires if a teammate/another source restores Cover HP.

⚑ skill1 burst-CDR: 'stacks up to 2 time(s) and lasts for 12 sec' is not expressible — `burstCdr` has no stack cap or window. Modeled as ONE 13s reduction per tia burst cast (one cover-recovery source ⇒ one stack). If a second cover-recovery source exists in a real fight, the model under-credits by up to 13s of her 40s burst CD.

⚑ burst 'Re-enters Burst Stage 1' has NO engine primitive (burstEligibility/fullBurstExtend/burstCdr are all different mechanics). It is a rotation-machine feature that can add a whole extra Burst-Stage-1 cast per chain — potentially the single largest damage term in this kit, and it is currently INERT.

⚑ skill2 self lifesteal HoT ('Recovers 21.96% of attack damage as HP over 10 sec') is deliberately NOT emitted as heal/recovery events: it restores the unit's HP, not Cover HP, so emitting it would spuriously fire cover-keyed consumers (and, on 10 ticks, multiply any on-recovery rider). No HP pool is modeled, and no ally consumer exists (target is self).

⚑ 'Max HP of Cover ▲' targets the COVER entity, which the sim has no representation of; encoding it as casterMaxHpPct/targetMaxHpPct would wrongly inflate the unit's own Max HP (a future atkOfMaxHpPct feed). Skipped, not silently merged.
⚑ Cadence tuple (ammo 6 / reloadFrames 141 / chargeFrames 60 / RL pull rate) comes from the datamine fields known to be unreliable — unverified against footage.
The two `shield` effects and the `heal` effect carry no HP pool (v1 boss deals no damage); they exist for kit completeness and to fire teammates' `shielded` / `recovery` triggers.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Tia (RL/Iron/Defender/Burst I) is a shield/sustain Burst I whose only offensive term is skill1's team-wide Attack Damage ▲32.11%/10s, chained off her own burst cast (burst cast → skill2 restores Cover HP → skill1 fires), so the buff opens at cast time and covers the following Full Burst window. Her burst-CD reduction is modeled as one 13s application per own-burst cast. Cover Max HP, taunt, self lifesteal HoT and the 'Re-enters Burst Stage 1' rotation effect are unmodeled (see caveats); the last of these is the biggest known gap.

flags.estimate: {kind:'burstCast'} — fires once per tia burst cast
flags.reasoning: Kit trigger is 'when recovering Cover's HP'. The engine's `recovery` trigger fires on any heal targeting the unit; in NIKKE an ally heal restores unit HP, not Cover HP, so `recovery` would over-fire in any comp with a healer (helm/crown), inflating a team-wide 32.11% Damage-Up buff. The only kit-stated cover-HP restore is her own skill2 burst-cast line, so burstCast is the exact, non-over-firing equivalent.
flags.recipe: Record a fight with tia + a healer (e.g. crown/helm). Count tia's Attack-Damage-▲ buff icon applications: if it refreshes on ally heals (not just her own burst), re-key to {kind:'recovery'} and add the heal chain from skill2; if it appears only at her burst banner, burstCast is confirmed.

With a single modeled cover-recovery source only one stack can accrue, so 13s is the honest floor; a second in-game cover-recovery source within 12s would double it and shorten her 40s burst CD to ~14s.
flags.recipe: Time tia's burst-banner-to-burst-banner interval in footage with a stopwatch anchored to the 03:00→02:59 frame. 40−13=27s ⇒ 1 stack; ~14s ⇒ 2 stacks. Cross-check the buff-bar stack pip count on her portrait at cast.

flags.reasoning: This is a burst-rotation state-machine effect, not a stat/damage effect, and no EffectDef expresses it (burstEligibility grants a unit an extra stage, fullBurstExtend lengthens FB, burstCdr shifts cooldowns — none re-open stage 1 for the whole team). Because full-burst COUNT is the sim's measured-exact rotation invariant, an unmodeled stage re-entry is a first-order rotation error, not a rounding one.

If the real chain shows two stage-1 casts (or an extra FB) per rotation vs the sim's one, the effect is live and needs an engine primitive; log the delta rather than fudging a stat buff to absorb it.
